# Card M0 — the sound source (R0)

**Goal:** Julien can choose a soundfont by ear from a one-minute reel, the build can render through any bank without the bank being in git, and two tools exist for every later round: the audition reel and the stem audit.

**Read first:** your brief; `sed -n '/^### 2.7/,/^### 2.8/p' docs/PLAN-music-rewrite.md`; `tools/audio/render.mjs` (45 lines); `sed -n '1,40p;120,175p' tools/audio/build.py`; `grep -n "def render_midi" -A 8 tools/audio/post.py`; `sed -n '/^def downtown/,/^def play_sections/p' tools/audio/compose.py`.

## Files
- Own: `tools/audio/render.mjs`, `tools/audio/post.py` (`render_midi` only), `tools/audio/build.py` (steps 2 and 4 only), new `tools/audio/fetch_bank.sh`, `tools/audio/BANKS.md`, `tools/audio/reel.py`, `tools/audio/audit.py`, `tools/audio/sketch_r0.py`; `.gitignore`; `docs/build/music/reports/M0.md`; `AUDIOLOG.md` (step 8 only).
- Do not change: any chart in `compose.py`, `assets/audio/**`, `src/audio/**`. This round ships no sound.

## Steps
- [ ] **1. Set up and baseline.** Install as your brief says. Run one full `python3 build.py > /tmp/build.log 2>&1; tail -4 /tmp/build.log` and note the minutes it took. Then put the tree back: `git checkout -- assets/audio src/audio/manifest.ts`. `build/report.json` stays for partial builds.
- [ ] **2. Ignore rules and a safe partial build.** Add `tools/audio/build/` and `tools/audio/banks/` to `.gitignore`; `git ls-files tools/audio/build | head -3` prints nothing. Make `python3 build.py <names>` stop with a clear message when `build/report.json` is missing, instead of writing a manifest with only those cues.
- [ ] **3. Banks.** `fetch_bank.sh <letter>` is idempotent, puts or links the file under `tools/audio/banks/`, and prints its size and sha256. A = the system `TimGM6mb.sf2`. B = `fluid-soundfont-gm` (apt). C = `musescore-general-soundfont` (apt; find the file with `dpkg -L`). D = GeneralUser GS from `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrbumpy409/GeneralUser-GS/main/` (find the `.sf2` path in the repo's README). Run `apt-get update -qq` first. Give each bank 10 minutes; drop one that won't fetch, or won't load in `spessasynth_core` 4.4.2, and say so. With no argument the script fetches the bank named in `tools/audio/BANK`, and does nothing if that file is missing.
  Write `tools/audio/BANKS.md`: letter, name and version, MB, sha256, licence name, and the path or URL where you read the licence (for apt packages, `/usr/share/doc/<package>/copyright`). Include A. State what the file says; give no opinion on what it permits.
- [ ] **4. Bank switch.** `render.mjs` uses `SF2` from the environment, else the path on the one line of `tools/audio/BANK` (relative to `tools/audio/`), else TimGM6mb as today. `build.py` writes the bank's name and sha256 to `tools/audio/build/bank.json` (a separate file: `write_manifest` iterates `report.json` and must not meet a new key).
- [ ] **5. Stem audit** (`audit.py <loop>…`). For a loop, render its lead tracks alone and everything else alone through the current bank, with the loop's mastering but no normalisation, and print lead LUFS, bed LUFS and lead minus bed. Which tracks are leads comes from the chart (the `leads=` it passes to `lofi_finish`, or a `LEADS` entry you add beside it). Run it on today's `downtown`, `suburbs` and `industrial` through bank A: this tests the plan's guess that the leads sit 2–3 dB above the bed.
- [ ] **6. Timbre table: a proxy, not an audition.** For each bank and each of these programs (0-based GM): Rhodes 4, nylon guitar 24, jazz guitar 26, clean guitar 27, vibraphone 11, marimba 12, kalimba 108, harp 46, celesta 8, flute 73, warm pad 89, acoustic bass 32, and for reference accordion 21 and muted trumpet 59. Play the city motif's opening phrase at velocity 64 around middle C, then one 2-second note. Measure: spectral centroid in Hz; the share of energy between 2 and 5 kHz; the sustain ratio (RMS from 1.0 to 1.5 s over RMS of the first 0.2 s of the held note; a high ratio is a drone); and whether the bank has its own preset or fell back to another. Put the table in the measures file with one sentence above it saying these numbers are a proxy for harshness and droning and that nobody has listened.
- [ ] **7. The reel.** `reel.py <preset>` writes `build/reel/<preset>.mp3` (stereo, 128 kbps) and `<preset>.txt` (clip number, start time as m:ss, label). Clips get a 0.3 s fade in and out and a 0.7 s gap. **One static gain for the whole reel**, set so the reel measures about −16 LUFS: no `loudnorm`, no per-clip matching, so level differences between cues survive.
  - Preset `R0`: clip 1 is today's Downtown through A, starting at the first bar in which the accordion plays (skip the lead-free intro). Clips 2–5 are the same bars from `sketch_r0.py` through A, B, C and D: the chart untouched except that the accordion's program becomes nylon guitar (24) at 0.7 × velocity (remap the composed MIDI with `mido`; don't edit the chart). 12 seconds each, same mastering as the build gives a loop (`post.lofi_loop`, −20 LUFS). Labels carry the letter and the bank name.
  - Preset `R1`: the first 30 s of each file in `assets/audio/music/`, in the order downtown, downtown_sparse, suburbs, waterfront, university, industrial, uptown, megaslice_hq.
  - Presets are a list in the script, so later cards add `R2` as data.
- [ ] **8. Report.** `docs/build/music/reports/M0.md` starts with the letter table (letter, bank, file, MB, licence name), then the stem audit, then the timbre table, then the full-build minutes. Append to `AUDIOLOG.md`, under a new `## Music rewrite (2026-11-15)` heading at the end: three lines on R0 (banks compared, the audit result, "not auditioned yet").

## Checks
`node --check tools/audio/render.mjs`; `python3 -m py_compile tools/audio/*.py`; `git status --short assets/audio src | head -3` prints nothing; `ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of csv=p=0 tools/audio/build/reel/R0.mp3` is between 55 and 80; `rm -f tools/audio/BANK && python3 build.py downtown > /tmp/b.log 2>&1; tail -2 /tmp/b.log; git checkout -- assets/audio src/audio/manifest.ts` (a build with no BANK file still passes).

## Needs line
End your report's `Needs:` with: `Bank: recommend <letter> — <two numbers from the timbre table>; licence <name>`. Prefer, among banks whose licence file is clear, the one with the lowest 2–5 kHz share and sustain ratio on the front instruments.
